summary: Material relation-integration gap: persisted v2 relations are omitted from dataset snapshots. Most sealed domain contracts have meaningful tests, but warrant preservation lacks an independent oracle. Review was static; supplied test results were not independently rerun.

evidence: Read all of diff.patch and all five changed files; product changes concern L11 relation metadata, admission, compatibility, tests and documentation.
Compared the changed paths and behavior with plan.md and L11 in tree/loop/backlog.toml.
Mapped all ten expanded sealed criteria to constructor, admission, compatibility and persistence tests; inspected rejection paths for specific errors and unchanged stored rows.
Checked I1–I2: fixtures are TEST-ONLY; absent values remain absent and legacy purposes remain UNSPECIFIED.
Checked I3, I5–I9: predecessor and intent pins are validated; relation admission contains no evaluation, provenance promotion, decision execution, aggregation or confidence arithmetic.
Checked I12: tree/src/eval_lab/presentation.py:53 constructs an explicit allowlist; test_private_relation_text_never_changes_public_payload covers public/embed and blind/revealed states.
tree/src/eval_lab/relation_v2.py:111 registers the type, and tree/src/eval_lab/persistence.py:218 integrates transactional pin validation.

tree/src/eval_lab/pilot.py:338 does not discover RelationClaimV2 records; tree/src/eval_lab/pilot_domain.py:150 rejects them as submission artifacts. Consequently, ordinary dataset snapshots cannot retain these relations.
tree/docs/relations-v2.md:5 explicitly leaves snapshot discovery unchanged; none of the new tests checks snapshot inclusion.

tree/tests/test_relation_v2.py:52 uses identical purpose and warrant text. The privacy fixture also assigns the same sentinel to both at line 403. Replacing a supplied warrant with purpose could therefore escape these tests.

tree/tests/test_relation_v2.py:84 derives the canonical expected payload from the implementation's model_dump, and line 148 compares restored warrant against the constructed object rather than an independently authored literal.

Parsed all three changed Python files successfully. gate.json reports 698 passed, including the new cases; the available interpreter lacks pytest, Pydantic and SQLAlchemy, so execution was not independently verified.
Read changed comments, docstrings, documentation and report claims; found no external method or standards claims requiring research.
Independently verified the diff hash and all four reported product-file SHA-256 values.
Independently counted 641 changed product lines, matching the report and gate.json.
Compared documented vocabulary, endpoint restrictions, compatibility semantics and admission behavior against their implementations. Documentation explicitly acknowledges the snapshot limitation.
Compared the complete diff against the sealed file list and DEFERRED items D01–D14; found no unrelated implementation or deferred capability.
Checked I4, I10–I11 and I16: no protected artifacts, dependencies, existing tests, harness files, schemas or judging contracts are changed.

Checked I13–I15: versions and hashes are recorded, fixed-input replay tests exist, and the diff contains no publication or branch operations. Supplied G14 evidence reports unchanged pilot listing and remote main.

blocking_findings.description: RelationClaimV2 is persisted but cannot enter the existing dataset snapshot discovery path. Snapshot roots include submissions, sessions, derivatives and bindings; submission envelopes reject RelationClaimV2, and reference traversal only follows outgoing links. A relation pointing to included evidence or intent therefore remains absent from the exported snapshot, losing its purposes, warrant and anchors from the reproducible review artifact. The sealed plan excludes snapshot discovery, but that exclusion conflicts with the evaluator's explicit requirement that new types be pinned in snapshots.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Resolve the sealed-plan conflict and provide narrowly scoped private snapshot inclusion for applicable v2 relations and their exact revision dependencies. Add a test that stores a relation, snapshots and exports its dataset, asserts its reference, digest and authored fields are retained, and verifies an earlier export remains unchanged after a successor is added.

loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Add passing tests that exercise an isolated record while leaving it absent from downstream review artifacts.
loophole_audit.evidence: The new module tests repository storage but contains no snapshot test. tree/src/eval_lab/pilot.py:338 and tree/src/eval_lab/pilot_domain.py:150 leave v2 relations undiscoverable.

loophole_audit.criterion: Expanded criterion 1: additive v2 record preserving v1 and all predicates.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Add fields to v1, changing historical hashes, or support only one predicate.
loophole_audit.evidence: RelationClaim remains unchanged. test_all_predicates_keep_endpoints_and_optional_unknowns exercises all eight predicates; test_legacy_loader_and_append_only_reopen_preserve_stored_bytes checks retained rows and identity.

loophole_audit.criterion: Expanded criterion 2: explicit, independent purpose vocabularies.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Infer purposes from predicates or accept UNSPECIFIED for new records.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_independent_purpose_vocabularies_and_fixed_input_replay supplies all 56 combinations with literal expected labels. test_new_authoring_requires_explicit_known_purposes rejects omitted and invalid values through construction and copied-object admission.

loophole_audit.criterion: Expanded criterion 3: anchors belong to the exact pinned intent.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Accept any criterion ID found in another intent or its latest revision.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_exact_intent_anchor_and_evidence_boundaries rejects unknown, newer-only, other-intent and legacy anchors plus digest mismatches. test_retained_binding_allows_old_revision_without_selecting_latest checks historical selection.

loophole_audit.criterion: Expanded criterion 4: authored warrant and optional text.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Use free-text purpose as the warrant or silently normalize authored text.
loophole_audit.evidence: Implementation retains separate fields without inference. test_support_and_contradiction_require_the_authors_warrant rejects absent/blank warrants; literal qualifier and rebuttal assertions detect normalization. Warrant substitution itself is insufficiently tested because purpose and warrant fixtures coincide.

loophole_audit.criterion: Expanded criterion 5: endpoint, evidence-kind and interval restrictions.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Validate only field shapes and allow semantically invalid endpoints or cross-intent hypotheses.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_all_predicates_keep_endpoints_and_optional_unknowns, test_direct_admission_revalidates_contract, test_self_relation_is_rejected_even_across_hypothesis_revisions and hypothesis boundary cases assert targeted rejection errors.

loophole_audit.criterion: Expanded criterion 6: complete admission validation and retained evidence bindings.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Validate constructors only, or ignore an evidence subject omitted from the evidence list.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_anchored_relation_requires_retained_exact_binding first rejects an unbound subject, then admits it after binding. Boundary cases reject extra unbound evidence, wrong media and wrong intent revisions; reject() checks that failed admissions leave stored rows unchanged.

loophole_audit.criterion: Expanded criterion 7: append-only revisions and exact predecessors.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Accept arbitrary predecessor references or overwrite an existing revision.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_predecessor_pin_rejections covers missing, skipped, wrong-kind, wrong-ID and wrong-digest predecessors. test_legacy_loader_and_append_only_reopen_preserve_stored_bytes rejects conflicts and compares database rows across reopening and append.

loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Check conflicts only when the relation is inserted after the set, or only for v1 relations.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_exclusive_sets_cover_both_versions_orders_and_copied_admission covers versions, endpoint orders and insertion orders. test_competing_writers_cannot_commit_conflicting_v2_relation_and_set requires exactly one committed record.

loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Rewrite legacy rows or manufacture warrants and purposes during loading.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_legacy_loader_and_append_only_reopen_preserve_stored_bytes asserts literal UNSPECIFIED values, absent argument text, unchanged rows and source identity, frozen assignment rejection and nonpersistability.

loophole_audit.criterion: Expanded criterion 10: independent structural, preservation and privacy tests.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Generate expected values from the object under test so incorrect field transformations pass consistently.
loophole_audit.evidence: tree/tests/test_relation_v2.py:84–98 derives the canonical oracle from model_dump and compares reload against the same constructed object. Literal assertions cover several fields, but warrant preservation uses matching fixture values and an object-to-object comparison at line 148. Negative admission and privacy checks otherwise have meaningful failure conditions.

flags: Independent pytest execution unavailable: the accessible interpreter lacks pytest, Pydantic and SQLAlchemy. Supplied gate results are reported evidence, not an independent rerun.
